api.notes: Semantic name or namespaced key from the registry (attribute `name`, A§12). The upstream 'SVG component' form is the default slot: slot an <svg>.
Non-empty: role=img + name via ElementInternals; empty: decorative (host aria-hidden).

api.reason: A-xstyle: use class/style, ::part(icon), the size and colour attributes, or --icon-stroke-width.

api.notes: Custom SVG (upstream component mode) and fallback for an unregistered name.

hooks.notes: @tecton-astryx/core/icons/registry.js returns the IconDefinition or lazy loader.
Same name; layers (`priority: 'default'`), namespaces and lazy loaders; notifies rendered icons.
The library-default-plus-override seam is registerIcons(..., {priority: 'default'}); a per-call fallback is the tct-icon default slot.

hooks.reason: Render-prop helper for React children. Owners render <tct-icon name> in a template or slot; there is nothing to port.

hooks.notes: Owning components set the private --_icon-size on the element that owns the icon slot; it inherits through the slot and an explicit size still wins.

differences.text: Sizes come from the Tecton icon size tokens (--tecton-icon-size-50/100/150/200 = 12/16/20/24 px) instead of 0.75/1/1.25/1.5 rem, so they no longer scale with the root font size.
`icon` is the `name` attribute (A§12); the SVG-component form of `icon` is the default slot, which is also the fallback when `name` is not registered (upstream renders nothing).

Decorative or labelled semantics are default ElementInternals state on the host (aria-hidden, or role=img and name), so host attributes override them exactly as the upstream prop spread lets an explicit aria-* win. The inner <svg> is always aria-hidden.
color="accent" paints --color-icon-accent (the Tecton adornment ink) because --color-accent is a fill in Tecton (tecton-astryx components.ts `icon` override).
The built-in set is registered lazily by the first tct-icon that connects (lowest priority, A§12), not at module load.

core.icon.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessible-web-components] ARIA defaults via ElementInternals; [mwg:sanitize-untrusted-html] and [mwg:trusted-types] raw SVG bodies go through sanitizeHtml once and are cloned; [mwg:custom-elements] observed attributes, upgrade order; [mwg:styling-web-components] ::slotted sizing and part; [mwg:css] logical properties and layers.
